#include <random>

using namespace std;

const int mod = 998244353;

long long Pow(long long a, long long b) {
    long long ans = 1;
    while (b > 0) {
        if ((b & 1) != 0) ans = (ans * a) % mod;
        a = (a * a) % mod;
        b >>= 1;
    }
    return ans;
}

class InputReader {
public:
    istream &stream;
    string nextToken;
    InputReader(istream &stream) : stream(stream) {}
    string next() {
        if (!hasNext()) {
            throw runtime_error("No more tokens");
        }
        return nextToken;
    }
    int nextInt() {
        return stoi(next());
    }
    long long nextLong() {
        return stoll(next());
    }
    bool hasNext() {
        string token;
        stream >> token;
        if (stream.fail()) {
            stream.clear();
            stream.ignore(10000, '\n');
            return false;
        }
        nextToken = token;
        return true;
    }
};

void solve() {
    InputReader in(cin);
    cout << flush;
    int n = in.nextInt(), k = in.nextInt(), l = in.nextInt();
    vector<long long> fac(n + 1);
    fac[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        fac[i] = fac[i - 1] * i % mod;
    }
    vector<vector<long long>> dp(2 * n + 1, vector<long long>(2 * n + 2));
    dp[0][0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= 2 * n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
            if (j > 0) dp[i][j] = (dp[i][j] + dp[i - 1][j - 1]) % mod;
            dp[i][j] = (dp[i][j] + dp[i - 1][j + 1] * (j + 1) % mod) % mod;
        }
    }
    long long ans = 0;
    for (int i = k; i <= 2 * n; i++) {
        for (int j = k; j <= n; j++) {
            ans = (ans + dp[i][j] * dp[2 * n - i][j] % mod * fac[j] % mod) % mod;
        }
    }
    cout << (l * ans % mod * Pow(dp[2 * n][0], mod - 2) % mod * Pow(2 * n + 1, mod - 2) % mod) << endl;
}

int main() {
    try {
        solve();
    } catch (exception &e) {
        cerr << e.what() << endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
